intro: Chennai is further from the mountains than most big Indian cities. Its closest hill stations, Yelagiri and Horsley Hills, are small and quiet, about four to five hours away. Yercaud and the Kolli Hills need a longer weekend, and Kodaikanal and Ooty are best reached by overnight train or bus.
For a longer break, the overnight journey means you arrive in the hills with a full day ahead.
quickAnswer: The nearest hill stations to Chennai are Yelagiri (about 230 km) and Horsley Hills (about 250 km), each four to five hours by road. Yercaud (about 340 km) and the Kolli Hills (about 370 km) suit a long weekend, while Kodaikanal and Ooty are best by overnight train or bus. October to March is the best season; vehicles need a free e-pass for Kodaikanal and Ooty.
takeaways: Yelagiri is the easiest weekend hill station from Chennai.
Yercaud and the Kolli Hills need a long weekend.
Kodaikanal and Ooty are best by overnight train or bus.
Vehicles need an e-pass to enter Kodaikanal and Ooty.
April and May are busy; October to March is calmer and cooler.

items.name: Yelagiri and Horsley Hills
body: A lake, easy trails and quiet stays at Yelagiri; viewpoints and forest at Horsley Hills.

items.name: Yercaud and the Kolli Hills
body: Yercaud's lake and coffee estates via Salem; the Kolli Hills' 70 hairpin bends and waterfalls.

items.name: Kodaikanal, Ooty and Munnar
body: Overnight trains to Kodaikanal Road, Madurai, Coimbatore or Mettupalayam put you in the hills by midday.

sections.heading: When to go
list: October to March: cool and pleasant; the best time.
April to May: busy with summer holidays; book early.
June to September: the Nilgiris get monsoon rain; the Eastern Ghats hills are warmer but greener.

sections.heading: Where to stay
paras: Yelagiri and Yercaud have small resorts, lake-side hotels and state tourism properties. Horsley Hills has a handful of stays, including the Andhra Pradesh tourism resort, so book ahead. For Kodaikanal and Ooty, stay near the lake for convenience or a little outside for quiet and views.

sections.heading: Tips
list: Book overnight trains to Madurai, Kodaikanal Road or Coimbatore early for long weekends.
Carry a light jacket; nights are cool even in the smaller hills in winter.
Summer weekends in Yercaud and Kodaikanal are busy; weekdays are much calmer.
Vehicles need an e-pass for Kodaikanal and Ooty.

sections.heading: About the Eastern Ghats hills
paras: The hills nearest Chennai belong to the Eastern Ghats, which are lower, older and drier than the Western Ghats. Places such as Yelagiri, the Javadhu hills and the Kolli Hills are about forest, fruit orchards, small lakes and village life rather than tea estates and misty peaks. They are pleasant rather than cold, and at their best from October to February.

sections.heading: Combining with other places
list: Yelagiri with Vellore's fort and temple.
Yercaud with a stop in Salem.
Kodaikanal with Madurai's Meenakshi Amman temple.
Ooty with Coimbatore and the Isha Yoga Centre's Adiyogi.

safety: Drive times are approximate and depend on traffic, weather and road works; weekend traffic on hill roads can double them. Avoid driving on mountain roads after dark.
Check weather and road updates before leaving, especially in the monsoon.
Book stays early for long weekends.

faqs.q: Which is the nearest hill station to Chennai?
faqs.a: Yelagiri, about 230 km away, and Horsley Hills in Andhra Pradesh.

faqs.q: Can I visit Ooty from Chennai for a weekend?
faqs.a: It is possible with overnight trains both ways, but three days is more comfortable.

faqs.q: Is Yercaud good for a weekend from Chennai?
faqs.a: It is better as a long weekend, about six to seven hours by road or via a train to Salem.

faqs.q: Do I need an e-pass for Kodaikanal?
faqs.a: Vehicles from outside the district need a free e-pass; check the Tamil Nadu e-pass portal.
